claim_limit: The BTS final schedule is a retrospective T-24 schedule proxy. Prior-year frontiers are empirical scheduling envelopes, not physical AAR/ADR. NASR gives static geometry, not active configurations. Optional operational constraints have zero coverage unless an authentic issue-time-vintaged feed is supplied. Boundary flights are context-only and do not change the scored population.
context_population: all BTS flights touching a frozen top-100 endpoint
